summary: Public Playground with Sandbox Mode - All features tested and working. Fixed a race condition bug where authenticated users were seeing sandbox API key instead of their own.

issues: React hydration warning: <span> cannot be a child of <option> - cosmetic issue from dev tools injection

backend: Sandbox agent has required fields (agent_id, name, score, tier, outcome_count, success_rate)
Sandbox API key can get agent score
Sandbox API key can submit outcome
Sandbox API key can list outcomes
Sandbox API key can get badge SVG
Sandbox cannot create new agents (expected behavior)
frontend: Playground page loads without login at /playground
Back to Dashboard hidden in sandbox mode
Sandbox Support Bot in agent dropdown
Execute request works in sandbox mode (200 OK)
Authenticated mode: Back to Dashboard visible
Authenticated mode: User's own API key shown (arl_4d72...)

critical_code_review_comments: Fixed race condition in PlaygroundPage.jsx useEffect - added isCancelled flag to prevent stale state updates when user changes
Sandbox endpoint properly excludes MongoDB _id from responses
API key masking works correctly in both modes
seed_data_creation: Sandbox user and agent created via setup_sandbox.py script. SANDBOX_API_KEY and SANDBOX_USER_ID set in backend/.env
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public playground with sandbox mode fully tested. Sandbox endpoint at GET /api/sandbox/credentials returns shared API key and demo agent. PlaygroundPage.jsx has dual-mode logic that checks if user is logged in. Fixed race condition bug where authenticated users were seeing sandbox API key - added isCancelled flag to useEffect cleanup.

sandbox_mode.signup_cta: Working - 'Sign up free' button and banner
sandbox_mode.execute_request: Working - can submit outcomes, get scores

authenticated_mode.auth_banner: Working - 'All requests use your live API key'
authenticated_mode.api_key: Working - user's own key displayed (not sandbox)

response.agents: List of sandbox agents with scores

bug_fixed.description: Race condition in PlaygroundPage.jsx where authenticated users saw sandbox API key
bug_fixed.root_cause: useEffect ran twice - first with user=null (sandbox), then with user object. Sandbox API call could complete after authenticated API call, overwriting the correct key.
bug_fixed.fix: Added isCancelled flag in useEffect cleanup to prevent stale state updates when user changes
